title: David was amazing!
text: David was fantastic!! He explained where to meet with precision in a busy place. I booked the Spanish speaking tour (as it was the only one left for our visit to Barcelona) and while my wife speaks Spanish, I planned to just use my headphones and Google translate. David is bilingual and was offering to do both, however the other 2 members of our tour group didn't speak English. Throughout the tour, David frequently checked in in re: my comprehension of the tour. I appreciated his kindness and his thorough explanations of Sagrada Familia - he made our visit memorable!
author: melaniefM314HI

title: Museum
text: The museum visit was brief but still quite interesting to discover some additional details about the construction of the Sagrada Familia, and especially to admire various historical photos taken during the different phases of the work.
author: MicheleLecce
